attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "Scholarship Applications Overview",
  "subtitle": "Analysis of applicant demographics, academic performance, income levels, and application statuses across talukas",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Applicants",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applicants FROM \"scholarship_applicants\"",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average Marks",
      "sql": "SELECT ROUND(AVG(\"Marks %\"), 2) AS avg_marks FROM \"scholarship_applicants\"",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average Family Income",
      "sql": "SELECT ROUND(AVG(\"Family Income\"), 0) AS avg_income FROM \"scholarship_applicants\"",
      "unit": "₹"
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "pie",
      "title": "Application Status Distribution",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Status\" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM \"scholarship_applicants\" WHERE \"Status\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Status\" ORDER BY count DESC",
      "x": "status",
      "y": "count"
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Applicants by Taluka",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Taluka\" AS taluka, COUNT(*) AS applicant_count FROM \"scholarship_applicants\" WHERE \"Taluka\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Taluka\" ORDER BY applicant_count DESC LIMIT 15",
      "x": "taluka",
      "y": ["applicant_count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Average Marks by Social Category",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Category\" AS category, ROUND(AVG(\"Marks %\"), 2) AS avg_marks FROM \"scholarship_applicants\" WHERE \"Category\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Category\" ORDER BY avg_marks DESC",
      "x": "category",
      "y": ["avg_marks"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Scheme Summary: Applicants, Income & Marks",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Name of scheme\" AS scheme_name, COUNT(*) AS total_applied, ROUND(AVG(\"Marks %\"), 1) AS avg_marks_pct, ROUND(AVG(\"Family Income\"), 0) AS avg_family_income, COUNT(CASE WHEN \"Status\" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 END) AS successful_apps FROM \"scholarship_applicants\" WHERE \"Name of scheme\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY \"Name of scheme\" ORDER BY total_applied DESC"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "A total of {{p1.total_applicants}} students have applied across various scholarship programs. The overall applicant pool demonstrates strong academic performance with an average score of {{p2.avg_marks}}% and an average reported annual family income of {{p3.avg_income}}.\n\nApplications are distributed across multiple administrative talukas, with key volume centers captured in the regional breakdown. Across social categories and distinct scholarship schemes, academic marks and financial eligibility remain central metrics evaluated alongside current application statuses."
}

      "kind": "bar",

      "y": ["avg_seconds_saved"]

    {
      "id": "p6",

      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Overdue Loan Count",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM \"shg_loan_register\" WHERE \"Repayment Status\" = 'Overdue'",

    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Overdue Principal Amount",
      "sql": "SELECT SUM(\"Loan Amount (Rs)\") AS overdue_amount FROM \"shg_loan_register\" WHERE \"Repayment Status\" = 'Overdue'",
      "unit": "Rs"
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "pie",
      "title": "Loans by Purpose",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Purpose\" AS purpose, SUM(\"Loan Amount (Rs)\") AS total_amount FROM \"shg_loan_register\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",

      "y": ["disbursed", "repaid"]
    },
